lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Do you always track things by smell?

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Ash has a specific scent when something has burned recently. You'd know if you paid attention.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: I pay attention to the wrong things, apparently.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: The ley-line through here is fractured. Fascinating and terrible.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Fascinating gets you killed out here.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: You burned three arrows with that spell.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: You won't. You'll be 'experimenting' with something else.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Tell me what you see when you look at the veil-edge.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Death wearing a thin coat. You?

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: A question I haven't found the courage to answer yet.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Correlation with the rifts. I have seventeen notes on it.
